instruction: Use ug-surveillance cameras to list all cameras with name, location and status. Read only. Do not return faces, plates or snapshots.

Use ug-surveillance faces with identity-type known to check whether exactly one known identity is named Ana Ruiz. Read only. Return yes or no, and if no, only the registered names that are closest to Ana Ruiz. Do not return images or details of anyone.

Use ug-document extract with schema auto and content-scope full on the file Invoices/Ana Ruiz - hours.pdf. Return one row per billed visit with date, start time, end time, billed hours, hourly rate, line amount, worker name and number of workers, plus the exact text each value was read from. Also return the bill total, currency and the period printed on the bill. Leave a value empty when it is not printed; do not compute or infer missing values. List any page or line that could not be read.

Use ug-surveillance event-timeline from 2026-11-02 00:00 to 2026-11-09 12:00 in time zone America/New_York, for the cameras Front Door, with topic Human and HumanFace, identity-type known, person-name Ana Ruiz and limit 500. Return every event with its event id, local time, camera and the identity name exactly as recorded, and say whether the list was cut at the limit. Read only. Do not return events of any other person. Report any warning about missing recordings or offline cameras.

Use ug-surveillance event-timeline in time zone America/New_York for the cameras Front Door on these dates only: 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-06, with topic Human and HumanFace, identity-type all and limit 500. For each event return only its local time, its camera and whether the person was recognised as a known identity (yes or no). Do not return names, faces, plates, snapshots or other details. Say whether any list was cut at the limit, and report any warning about missing recordings or offline cameras.

said:
Fair Hours: Ana Ruiz, 2026-11-02 to 2026-11-08 (America/New_York)
Bill: Invoices/Ana Ruiz - hours.pdf. The bill lists dates and hours only, with no start or end times. Camera: Front Door (entrance, online). Tolerance: 10 min. No agreed terms.

| Date | Billed | Seen at Front Door | Difference | Result | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Mon 2026-11-02 | 3 h 00 min (no times on bill) | 09:00 to 12:05 (3 h 05 min) | 5 min seen longer than billed | Confirmed | 2 events |
| Wed 2026-11-04 | 2 h 30 min (no times on bill) | 13:00 to 14:10 (1 h 10 min) | billed 1 h 20 min more than seen | Billed more than seen | 2 events |
| Fri 2026-11-06 | 3 h 00 min (no times on bill) | none | none | Not seen while the cameras recognised other people | 0 events; other people recognised at the door at 16:00 |

Totals
- Billed: 8 h 30 min over 3 visits.
- Confirmed: 3 h 00 min over 1 visit.
- Billed more than seen: 1 h 20 min over 1 visit. At the printed rate of 25 USD per hour, 33.33 USD.
- Seen more than billed: 0 h 00 min.
- Not seen while the cameras recognised other people: 3 h 00 min over 1 visit. At the printed rate, 75.00 USD.
- Inconclusive: none.

Bill arithmetic: all lines check out (3.0 x 25 = 75.00; 2.5 x 25 = 62.50; 3.0 x 25 = 75.00; total 212.50 USD).

What this means: the 2 Nov visit matches within tolerance. On 4 Nov the bill has 1 h 20 min more than the cameras saw; the cameras recognised Ana at 13:00 and 14:10, and no unrecognised person passed the door that day. On 6 Nov the door cameras recorded people passing but did not recognise Ana. Camera times show passages through the front door, not the work done between them, so the best next step is to go through 4 Nov and 6 Nov with Ana before drawing any conclusion.

Two things I can do next: (1) save this report on the NAS, if you tell me which folder; (2) prepare snapshots of the Front Door events on 4 Nov for your review on the NAS. Which would you like?
